set.content-security-policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

assets.raw_headers:
/*
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  Referrer-Policy: no-referrer
  X-Frame-Options: DENY
  Permissions-Policy: interest-cohort=()
  Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

# The service worker must always be revalidated, so a new deploy's SW is never pinned to a stale
# (possibly buggy) cached version that then controls the whole origin (audit re-sweep).
/sw.js
  Cache-Control: no-cache

oauth: Existing opaque OAuth reused through official Wrangler; no credential/config inspection
initialSandboxRead: blocked network; succeeded with authorized network access
preservationLimits: Cloudflare grouping tag normalization is explicitly user-approved; no tag values claimed preserved.
usage_model is not accepted by pinned Wrangler schema; active readback is standard and upload version must be checked before activation.
Version upload necessarily changes annotations/provenance; current config preserves keep_vars and does not write routes/schedules/domain mappings.
Dry-run skips asset attachment; uploaded assets metadata, immutable preview and live browser checks remain pending.
